dedupe_keys.name: ieodo station hourly ocean and atmosphere observations 2004 2023

description: The Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology publishes Ieodo Ocean Research Station hourly oceanic and atmospheric observations from 2004 to 2023. Its own repository page identifies two NetCDF files and explicitly states CC BY 4.0. The article names water temperatures at three depths and atmospheric temperature, wind, pressure, humidity and precipitation. These series can calibrate marine weather or coastal exposure scenarios near the northern East China Sea. Coverage is one offshore station with changes in instruments and quality-control algorithms over two decades. A caveat is that the provider lists later version updates, so users should cite the chosen version and inspect changed averaging or height-adjustment steps. The printed DOI did not resolve in DataCite during this check; the KIOST own page and handle were reachable. I read the own repository page and article Data Records without downloading NetCDF files or recalculating observations. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
